Name: MOVEMENT_RIDE_OBJ_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines movement parameters for objects and entities being ridden. Unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved for package export. Not used.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved for package export. Not used.

Fields.Name: Low-Speed Ground Brake Threshold
Fields.Description: Below this speed, the low-speed ground brake is used. In km/h.

Fields.Name: High-Speed Ground Brake Threshold
Fields.Description: Above this speed, the high-speed ground brake is used. In km/h.

Fields.Name: Low-Speed Brake Acceleration
Fields.Description: Horizontal braking on the ground at low speed. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: High-Speed Brake Acceleration
Fields.Description: Horizontal braking on the ground at high speed. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: (Aerial) Horizontal Brake Acceleration
Fields.Description: Braking applied in the air while horizontal speed is above the maximum, pulling it back down to the maximum. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: (Aerial) Vertical Brake Acceleration
Fields.Description: Braking applied in the air while vertical speed is above the maximum, pulling it back down to the maximum. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Actual Movement Feedback Rate
Fields.Description: Share of the actual movement that is applied. Lower values give a heavier feel.

Fields.Name: Minimum Animation Movement Acceleration
Fields.Description: Minimum guaranteed acceleration during animation-driven movement. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Low-Speed Brake Animation Speed
Fields.Description: Below this horizontal speed, the low-speed brake animation is used. In km/h.
